payload.title: File:Eoneophron infernalis Skeletal.png
payload.description_html: Skeletal of Eoneophron infernalis described by Atkins-Weltman et al.,(2024). CM 9523 (holotype), found in Meade County; South Dakota; USA. Aided using: Citipes elegans, Elmisaurus rarus, Anzu wyliei. Known material in white and unknown material in grey. It's in left lateral view, Elements from the right side were flipped over, Large box = 1 metre by 1 metre, Small box = 10 centimetres by 10 centimetres.
